note: E5 DROPWATCH-S full contrast set on gpt-5.5, reconstructed from cache (0 misses, no API). Pre-registered PRIMARY = dropwatch_stance-pin_fair on STRICT-MIN (worst-type worst-hop); it FAILED. Additional contrasts + the MEAN estimand are EXPLORATORY, reported alongside, not swapped in as the gate.

findings.1_rescue_real_on_mean: Both levers compose and each is CI-excl-0 on mean: preservation STANCE (+0.244) and RE-INJECTION (+0.200). Combined (pin_fair_faithful) roughly doubles mean retention 0.22->0.44 on the hardest aggressive compressor.
findings.2_adaptive_unnecessary: dropwatch_stance - pin_fair_faithful = -0.045 NS (slightly negative) on BOTH estimands. The adaptive detector/escalation does NOT earn its keep on aggressive compressors: a simple fixed 'always re-inject + always preserve' does as well or better, at equal cost. Reason: on gpt-5.5 drops are ubiquitous (faithful_hop_frac 0.94), so there is nothing to save by escalating only-when-needed.
findings.3_strictmin_gate_fails_for_all: On the pre-registered worst-type worst-hop estimand, NOTHING clears CI-excl-0 on gpt-5.5, because numeric is crushed to ~0 for every policy even with the rescue (best numeric per_type = 0.20). Worst-case numeric on the most aggressive compressor is near-lossy in-band -> offload to external memory (Pillar-4).
findings.4_unified_arc: The RIGHT controller depends on repair-retention (oracle). High-oracle models (Qwen, gpt-5.4): repairs stick, drops targetable -> adaptive DROPWATCH earns its keep (E4 PASS). Low-oracle aggressive compressors (gpt-5.5, Sonnet): repairs need preservation STANCE and drops are ubiquitous -> just always-preserve + re-inject (simple), adaptivity superfluous.

deliverable: The rescue method is SIMPLE, not the adaptive DROPWATCH-S: on aggressive compressors, compress under a preservation stance AND re-inject key facts (both levers CI-excl-0 on mean, compose to ~2x). The mechanism (stance is the causal lever, salience-labeling is not; both levers compose) is the contribution. Honest limits: (a) adaptive detection unnecessary on such models; (b) worst-case numeric strict-min unrescuable in-band -> offload.
